concerns.text: The ERA5 dataset URL points to a 1982 file (https://huggingface.co/datasets/zhixiangd/ERA5/resolve/main/1982_1.h5) which does not cover the required 2014‑2018 period for the study, violating FR‑001 that mandates hourly ERA5 data for 2014‑2018.

The auxiliary latency dataset is referenced as `data/raw/aux_response_times.csv`, but FR‑016 specifies the file should be named `data/raw/latency_study.csv`. This naming mismatch may cause validation failures against the contract.
